traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Pandaceae, which takes in Centroplacaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire, serrate or dentate; veins pinnate; stipules present; plants monoecious or dioecious; ovary superior; floral cup absent; stems woody; flowers solitary, in cymes or in panicles; flowers actinomorphic; perianth sepals and petals; fruit usually drupe, sometimes capsule; parts of each whorl 5; stamens 5 to 15; carpels 2 to 5. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
